news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹15.68 (vs ₹4.38 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹15.68 (up from ₹4.38 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹23.8b (up 47% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹501.7m (up 258% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 2.1% (up from 0.9% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 4% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 77% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
